## This qmd will compare the results obtained from human observation and from the HOG algorithm.

```{r}
# Libraries
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load data
human_df <- read_csv("../output/wind_summaries/humangrassanalysis.csv")
hog_df <- read_csv("../output/weighted_datasets/all_weighted_dataset.csv")

```

```{r}
hog_df
```



```{r}
# Calculate distances between human vs hog
diff_df <- data.frame(
  #image = human_df$Image,
  image = hog_df$image_name,
  human_angle = human_df$circular_mean,
  hog_angle = hog_df$circular_mean,
  circular_distance = circular_distance(human_df$circular_mean, hog_df$circular_mean, axial = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE))

diff_df
```

```{r}
# Find images with minimum angle differences
diff_df %>% slice_min(circular_distance, n = 50)

```


```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
# List of image names
images <- c("LL grass24 March 2023", "DJI_0362", "DJI_0346", "DJI_0358",
            "LL grass10 March 2023", "DJI_0363", "DJI_0373",
            "LL grass4 March 2023", "LL grass9 March 2023", "DJI_0345", "LL grass8 March 2023") # last image is a test
```

```{r}
# A df to retrieve circular mean of angle for hog and humans to plot on polar plot
filtered_df <- diff_df %>%
  filter(image %in% images)

filtered_df
```


```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=20}
# create a df to combine image files
all_df <- data.frame()

# loops through the images to create file
for (image in images) {
  file_path <- paste0("../output/angles_mags/", image, ".csv")
  df <- read_csv(file_path)
  df$image <- image   # add column for faceting
  all_df <- bind_rows(all_df, df)
}

# create plots and facet wrap them
ggplot(all_df, aes(x = theta)) +
  geom_histogram(
    colour = "black", 
    fill = "darkgreen", 
    breaks = seq(0, 360, length.out = 17.5)
  ) +
  coord_polar(theta = "x", start = 0, direction = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 360),
    breaks = c(0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315),
    labels = c("N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~image, ncol = 3) +
  # Human mean arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = filtered_df,
    aes(
      x = human_angle,
      xend = human_angle,
      y = 0,
      yend = 8000
    ),
    color = "darkblue",
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # HOG mean arrow
  geom_segment(
    data = filtered_df,
    aes(
      x = hog_angle,
      xend = hog_angle,
      y = 0,
      yend = 8000
    ),
    color = "darkred",
    size = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "") +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 10), 
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )

```
